subject: AWS Marketplace private offer — intercompany billing, clawback, and term sync

Subject: AWS private offer — billing split + term questions

Hi Amelia,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — appreciate the time and the clear product fit you outlined for Nimbus. Per our conversation, I put together a short private-offer proposal that maps to the 12-month pilot you described. Attaching a draft PO and the pricing worksheet for visibility.

Two things you raised that I want to flag early:
- Intercompany billing: you mentioned you need charges to flow to a central procurement entity while consumption attribution lands to individual business units.
- Clawback / headcount adjustment: you asked for a limited clawback window if headcount/usage materially changes after signing.

I copied Vivek and Marcus from finance/partnerships — they can confirm what’s supported on the AWS side and propose contract language. If Procurement wants, we can also loop in our legal ops for a targeted clause.

Next steps I suggest: 1) you confirm the billing entity and the BU attribution mechanism you prefer, 2) we review the attached PO draft and mark any redlines, and 3) we sync for a short 30-minute call with Procurement (you), our finance lead (Vivek), and me.

Attachments: Nimbus_PO_Draft_v2.pdf, Pricing_worksheet.xlsx

Best,

Tessa Morgan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: AWS private offer — billing split + term questions

Tessa — thanks for the materials. Quick answers and a couple of asks: 

- Billing entity: We need an invoice to go to Nimbus Health Inc (central finance) but show consumption by BU on the usage reports. Is that how AWS PO flow typically works?
- Clawback: Our procurement policy allows a 90–120 day adjustment window for staffing/contracted FTE changes; we prefer 90 days if possible. Any chance Redwood can accept a 90-day pro-rated clawback tied to confirmed usage?
- Term: The pilot is likely 12 months from signature but procurement will push for a 9-month auto-review clause.

Looping David (procurement consultant) on this thread to help with exact wording. Would like the 30-min call tomorrow afternoon if you and your finance/legal folks are available.

Thanks,

Amelia Park
Head of Procurement, Nimbus Health

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 13:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS private offer — billing split + term questions

Amelia / Tessa — quick note from finance/marketplace side.

On intercompany billing: AWS private offers invoice to the seller (Redwood) and charges flow through AWS, but we can do attribution reporting by linked account or by tags so your internal BU teams can see usage. If Nimbus needs the invoice addressed to Nimbus Health Inc, that’s straightforward; for per-BU chargeback we’ll rely on the usage export. We can include a short guide in the AWS_PO_Guidance.docx for your finance team.

On clawback: AWS marketplace has constraints around direct refund mechanics — the seller (us) must coordinate adjustments with the buyer and the marketplace. Redwood can accept a 90-day pro-rated adjustment window in the contract, but it will be operationalized as an invoice credit (not an AWS-side reversal) and will require a mutual attestation of the usage change. We will also require documentation (headcount change notice from an HR/Finance approver).

On term/review: 12-month pilot is fine. We can add a 9-month review checkpoint language where either party can request a repricing conversation; automatic term shortening to 9 months is risky from a revenue recognition standpoint. Let's surface that in the draft PO as a review clause rather than an auto-reduction.

I've attached the AWS_PO_Guidance.docx and a one-page ops note for Nimbus finance. Can we do the call tomorrow Aug 19 at 2pm PT?

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Finance, Redwood Inference

Folks — following the call: recap and suggested wording for the clawback and billing items.

On Wed, 19 Aug 2026 at 14:02, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Thanks all for the quick sync. Attached is the updated PO with the proposals we discussed.

Suggested contract snippets (draft language):
1) Billing & Reporting: "Seller will issue invoices to Nimbus Health Inc. Usage attribution will be provided via AWS usage exports, delineated by linked account and tags. Buyer will provide a central billing account identifier to be included on invoices."
2) Clawback / Adjustment: "Buyer may request a pro-rated credit up to 90 days post-signature subject to substantiation. Any credit will be processed as an invoice credit by Seller and reflected on the next billing cycle. Documentation required: Buyer HR/Finance attestation and usage report indicating delta."
3) Review Checkpoint: "Parties agree to a formal pricing review at month 9. Either party may initiate discussions; changes to pricing/term require mutual written agreement."

Amelia — two asks from our side to speed approval: a) confirm the central billing entity legal name and billing address for the invoice, and b) confirm the HR approver or finance contact who will sign any attestation for a clawback. If you can drop those two items in reply we can move to signature and DocuSign.

Thanks — David
Procurement Consultant, ProcureCo
